Element refs work for hub controls (zoom buttons, workspace dock) but not for ReactFlow canvas elements. This is a UI framework issue where the cookie banner portal intercepts all pointer events.

summary: Tested 39 assertions for spatial/zoom/canvas behavior. 8 assertions passed (overview renders, hub controls functional, no React errors). 31 assertions blocked - primarily due to cookie consent banner at z-index 280 intercepting all canvas pointer events, making workspace entry, canvas zoom/pan, and drag interactions impossible. Backend API returning 500 errors on some calls but not blocking initial render.
